scripts.clean:install: pnpm delete:dist && pnpm delete:buildinfo && pnpm delete:nm
scripts.build: pnpm -r run build && pnpm run docs
scripts.test: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm --filter @twnr/server test
scripts.docs: ts-json-schema-generator --path packages/shared/src/client-messages.ts --type ClientCommand -o docs/client-messages.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator --path packages/shared/src/server-messages.ts --type ServerResult -o docs/server-messages.schema.json && node scripts/dump-menu-registry.mjs && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs
